row.title: Branch cleanup root causes: unswept worker/ prefix, PRs with no required check, evidence branches outside KEEP
row.body: Measured: node --test seed/worker/test/sweeper.test.js pass 5 fail 0; open PR count went 4 to 0 after retriggering checks by hand. Built-in-token PRs never fire pull_request so required checks never report; worker/ branches were never swept; audit-evidence and ciwatch-evidence were missing from the sweep KEEP list. Fixed in sweeper.js and completion_sweep.sh. Open loop: Q-BRANCH-EVIDENCE-OFF-REFS moves evidence branches off git refs so main is the only branch; owner sweeper, trigger every tick, probe branch count equals 1.
